subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Experts acknowledged that some __counterfeiting of document__ techniques are virtually impossible to detect.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. forgery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"counterfeiting"** means the act of making an exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud. (जाली दस्तावेज़ बनाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The police arrested a gang involved in the counterfeiting of currency notes.
 
 
 
• **"Forgery" **refers to the crime of falsely making or altering a document with the intent to defraud. (जालसाजी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was convicted of forgery for signing the contract with a fake signature.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, "forgery" is the most appropriate term to substitute "counterfeiting of document".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. forgery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fiasco** (नाकामयाबी): A complete and embarrassing failure.

 
 
• **Example:** The event turned into a fiasco due to poor planning.
 
 
 
• **Impromptu** (तत्काल): Done without being planned or rehearsed.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave an impromptu speech at the wedding.
 
 
 
• **Frenzy** (उन्माद): A state of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** The crowd was in a frenzy during the concert.
